2020 Results Highlights                                                           二零二零年業績摘要
After the COVID-19 spreading reached its peak in China in the first quarter of    自新型冠狀病毒於二零二零年第一季度在中國
2020, our business continued to improve quarter by quarter and has achieved       爆發高峰後，本公司的業務每季度持續改善，

     The Company’s operation, working capital and cash flow were inevitably          自二零二零年一月新型冠狀病毒爆發以來，本
     disrupted by the COVID-19 outbreak since January 2020. Due to the               公司的運營、營運資金及現金流量無可避免地

     customer refunds, we experienced unfavorable working capital trends and         減少及客戶的退款率高，我們於二零二零年上
     stress on net cash flow generated from our operating activities in the first    半年經歷營運資金的不利趨勢及經營活動所得

     changes and adopted flexible operations strategy to capture the rebound         速回應市場變動並採取靈活的營運策略，以抓
     opportunities. We diversified our traffic through online channels and offline   緊反彈的商機。我們通過在線渠道及線下獲客
     user acquisition initiatives. As such, our average MAUs and average MPUs        措施令流量多元化，因此，我們的平均月活躍

Development in the PRC legislation on foreign investment                    有關外國投資的中國法例的發展
On March 15, 2019, the National People’s Congress promulgated the           於二零一九年三月十五日，全國人民代表
Foreign Investment Law (外商投資法) (the “FIL”), which took effect on            大會頒佈外商投資法（「外商投資法」），該
January 1, 2020. The FIL replaces the laws regulating foreign investment    法已於二零二零年一月一日生效。外商投
in PRC, namely, the Sino-foreign Equity Joint Venture Enterprise Law,       資法取代了中國規管外商投資的法律，即
the Sino-foreign Cooperative Joint Venture Enterprise Law and the           《中外合資經營企業法》、《中外合作經營企
Wholly Foreign-invested Enterprise Law. The FIL embodies an expected        業法》及《外資企業法》。外商投資法體現出
regulatory trend in PRC to rationalize its foreign investment regulatory    預期的中國監管趨勢，疏理其外商投資規
regime in line with prevailing international practice and the legislative   管制度以符合當前國際慣例及立法措施，
efforts to unify the corporate legal requirements for both foreign and      以統一國內外投資的公司法律規定。
domestic investments.


The FIL does not explicitly stipulate the contractual arrangements          外商投資法並無明確規定合約安排為一種
as a form of foreign investment. The FIL does not mention concepts          外商投資形式。外商投資法並無提及包括
including “de facto control” and “controlling through contractual           「實際控制權」及「通過合約安排進行控制」
arrangements” nor does it specify the regulation on controlling through     的概念，亦並無具體說明通過合約安排進
contractual arrangements. Furthermore, the FIL does not specifically        行控制的規定。此外，外商投資法並無具
stipulate rules on the Relevant Businesses. Instead, the FIL stipulates     體訂明就相關業務實行的規則。相反，外
that “foreign investors invest in PRC through any other methods under       商投資法規定「外國投資者通過法律、行政
laws, administrative regulations, or provisions prescribed by the State     法規或國務院規定的其他方式在中國境內
Council”. Therefore, as advised by the PRC legal Advisor, the Contractual   投資」。因此，根據中國法律顧問的建議，
Arrangements will not be affected under the FIL.                            合約安排不會受到外商投資法影響。

         accumulated impairment loss. Upon the acquisition of the                           營公司所有權權益後，該聯營公司

  2.15 Borrowings                                                                   2.15 借款
     Borrowings are recognized initially at fair value, net of transaction               借 款 初 步 按 公 允 價 值（ 扣 除 已 產 生 交
     costs incurred. Borrowings are subsequently carried at amortized                    易成本）確認。借款其後按攤銷成本計
     cost; any difference between the proceeds (net of transaction                       量。所得款項（扣除交易成本）與贖回
     costs) and the redemption value is recognized in the consolidated                   金額之間的任何差額於借款期內採用
     statement of comprehensive income over the period of the                            實際利率法於綜合全面收益表確認。
     borrowings using the effective interest method.


     Fees paid on the establishment of loan facilities are recognized as                 倘貸款融資很有可能部分或全部被提
     transaction costs of the loan to the extent that it is probable that                取，則就設立貸款融資時支付的費用
     some or all of the facility will be drawn down. In this case, the fee               確認為貸款交易成本。在此情況下，
     is deferred until the draw-down occurs. To the extent there is no                   費用遞延至提取發生為止。倘無任何

                  on an arm’s length basis.                                                    視為活躍。

                  These valuation techniques maximize the use of observable                    技術盡量利用既有可觀察市場數

                  entity specific estimates. If all significant inputs required to fair        倘計算某工具的公允價值所需的所
                  value an instrument are observable, the instrument is included               有重大輸入值為可觀察數據，則該
                  in level 2.                                                                  工具將列入第2層。

36. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                                        36. 關聯方交易
  Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly              倘一方有能力直接或間接控制另一方，或
  or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence                 能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
  over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties                響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
  are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.                 同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
  Members of key management and their close family member of the                           理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
  Group are also considered as related parties.
